module: Base class of the nodes of a flowgraph state graph. It extends flowgraph/basenode by adding eight "transition" pins on the node's edges (inputs and outputs N, E, S, W) and drawing them in the editor. A modder does not call it directly: it is used by state nodes.
notes: The created pins are named tInN/tInE/tInS/tInW and tOutN/tOutE/tOutS/tOutW, of type 'transition'.
Input pins are drawn with an arrow (PinArrowSize/Width = 20) and a LinkStrength of 0; output pins have no arrow.

M.createBase copies the methods of C directly into the object (o[k] = v): C:init therefore replaces basenode's init. basenode's init is indeed called first by basenode.createBase, but C:init(mgr) is then called with the same arguments and uses self.graph, which is already defined.

createBase.desc: Creates a basenode node, copies the state class methods (init, customDrawEnd, drawTransitionPin) onto it, then calls init(...).

....desc: arguments of basenode.createBase: mgr, graph, forceId

use.desc: Creates a state node, applies derivedClass on top, then runs _preInit, init (if redefined) and _postInit like basenode.use.

forceId.desc: forced identifier, otherwise the manager assigns one

derivedClass.desc: methods/fields of the concrete node type

init.desc: Creates the 8 transition pins (4 inputs, 4 outputs: N, E, S, W) via flowgraph/pin and stores them in self.transitionPins._in and ._out.

customDrawEnd.desc: Called by the builder at the end of node drawing (builder:End). Draws the 8 transition pins along the edges of the node rectangle (inputs on the counterclockwise sides, outputs on the clockwise sides).

drawTransitionPin.desc: Draws a rectangular transition pin at the given position with ui_flowgraph_editor (BeginPin, PinRect, PinPivotRect, EndPin) and stores pin.imPos.
